newsitem.title: USA: ARCO sees $300 mln gain from Lyondell.
newsitem.headline: ARCO sees $300 mln gain from Lyondell.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co said Monday it expects to book an after-tax gain of about $300 million to settle all of ARCO's nine percent exchangeable notes due Sept 15 in Lyondell Petrochemical Co.
In a statement, ARCO reiterated that Lyondell was no longer central to its core business or part of its strategic growth objectives.
ARCO currently owns 39.9 million shares, or 49.9 percent of the total outstanding shares of Houston-based Lyondell.
The company did not say in what quarter the gain would be booked. In a 1994 offering, ARCO sold $988 million of 3-year

Exchangeable Notes carrying a 9.0 percent annual coupon and payable, upon maturity, in shares of Lyondell Common Stock or, at ARCO's option, in cash with an equal value. ARCO said it choose the option to exchange Notes for stock.
